content: In every work of genius we recognize our own rejected thoughts; they come back to us with a certain alienated majesty.
author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
explanation: When we read great masters, we are startled to find our own intuitive flashes expressed boldly. Genius is simply the courage to honor thoughts that others dismiss.
practicalInsight: Pay attention to your quiet, subtle intuitions today instead of casting them aside as unworthy.
reflectionPrompt: What profound idea have you dismissed simply because it originated in your own mind?
